reviews.verification: Let t=tan x, so sin2x=2t/(1+t^2) and cos2x=(1-t^2)/(1+t^2). The other orders occur on open intervals separated by the curve crossings. This is an ordering task, not modulus-quadratic root counting; reject its proposed follow-up edge.
